item.title: Skate rack — from CAD to plywood
item.description: I had boards leaning in every corner, so I designed a vertical rack in CAD, cut angled slots in plywood, and built something that could hold skateboards and a snowboard without drilling into rental walls. December 2021; photos cropped from old stories. Version française.
